major_change_gate.decision_brief_markdown:
- 当前问题: ## 背景
- 目标: Lifecycle profile and trace matrix
- 背景: 来自 backlog R-248
- 可选方案:
  - 方案 A: 保持 backlog 范围，进入 spec -> plan -> go 标准流程
  - 方案 B: 补充分析，扩展本任务范围
- 推荐方案: 方案 A
- 决策理由: 方案 A 满足 backlog 声明的全部验收条件，且无额外依赖风险
- 不做什么: 不扩大到 backlog 未声明的产品/UI/架构范围
- 成本: 中等，按 plan 拆分后逐步验证
- 风险: 门禁推断可能不完整，执行前仍需 check/review 捕获漂移
- 回滚方案: 回滚本任务提交，或将 backlog 条目退回 proposed
- 用户确认: User agreed on 2026-07-06 to add this as a lightweight optional lifecycle layer with trace matrix subcommands and non-interactive regulated sources.

non_functional_requirements.text: 保持与现有 DocPath 工作流兼容

acceptance_criteria.text: docpath deliverables init/status/generate/check supports lifecycle profiles while preserving legacy deliverables list/render/check behavior. docpath trace matrix status/generate/check works without affecting trace show/session/health/anomaly. Lifecycle config is stored in .docpath/lifecycle.yaml and registry in .docpath/lifecycle-registry.json. Regulated profile sources are non-interactive optional declarations with warnings rather than default hard failures. Build and targeted command checks pass.
